scope: Fresh S386 full arc: supported-release stabilization of the scheduled Desk art pipeline that keeps CI Health Monitor red; direct main push and full deployment authorized.

investigation.baseline: Doctor blockingFailing=0; sched-staleness fails: CI Health Monitor failed 2026-10-15 and 2026-10-16 on check-desk-art-currency (2026-10-12 milk story on placeholder banner 92h > 48h; three stories without satire cartoons, 2026-10-09 reaching the 7-day blocking limit at ~2026-10-17T00:00Z). Autopilot log: identical rejections every run (landmarksMatchCountry, punchlineFits). Reviewer storyFor() supplies headline + scene only, while the generator prompt is driven by satire target/setup/payoff, caption and facts — the 2026-10-12 facts state the UK government is preparing to legislate, yet the reviewer reports no UK setting. Re-rolls reuse the same prompt with no rejection feedback. Release workflow 370760439 returned HTTP 422 (disabled) on two dispatches; art still reached production via later release (live bytes verified identical).

items.title: Give the Desk art reviewer the same story brief the generator drew from
items.recipe: storyFor() returns headline, scene, sourced fact lines, satire target/setup/payoff, caption and any satireDirection. reviewPrompt fences all of it as data; landmarksMatchCountry judges against the supplied facts; punchlineFits judges against the supplied joke/caption as well as the headline. Keep every strict check and the injection fence. Add self-tests that facts and caption reach the prompt and stay fenced.
items.acceptance: Self-tests pass, including fence-escape of every new field; a 2026-10-12 review prompt contains the UK-legislation fact and the caption. Next scheduled run uses the fixed reviewer; Desk art currency check turns green or each remaining rejection is a genuine image defect.
items.why: CI Health Monitor fails daily; the reviewer rejects faithful images it cannot verify.
items.stageRationale: Supported-release stabilization: public stories show placeholder art.

premises.claim: Reviewer receives only headline and scene

L2.recipe: Full brief parity with fencing and self-tests.

L3.recipe: Shared brief object consumed by both generator and reviewer.

executionLog.note: Reviewer brief parity live; 4 previously rejected or new cartoons approved and published, all live bytes matched; art currency green.

items.title: Carry the reviewer rejection into the next render prompt
items.pattern: const prompt = satire ? buildSatirePrompt(target.story, persona) : buildPrompt(target.story);
items.recipe: generateOne reads the staged review.json for that kind; when the last verdict failed, append a bounded, cleaned note naming the rejection reasons to avoid. Prompt hash in meta still reflects the actual prompt. Self-test both with and without a prior rejection.
items.acceptance: Generator self-tests pass; a forced re-roll after a recorded rejection writes a prompt containing the bounded reasons; no reasons are added after a pass.
items.why: Same rejection reasons repeated across 4+ runs with an unchanged prompt.
items.stageRationale: Converges stuck stories without weakening review.
